reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Moisture Airy Fit Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: This sunscreen is not good for hot weather. If you feel like you are going to sweat even a little bit don't wear this sunscreen, it will melt and gather around your cheeks and mouth. However if you are going to chill or be in a cool place it's great, the formula is very comfortable and cosmetic.
reviews.zh: 呢隻防曬唔適合熱天用。如果你覺得自己會出多過少少汗，就千祈唔好搽呢隻防曬，佢會溶晒同積埋喺你面頰同嘴邊。不過如果你係去 chill 或者身處涼爽地方，佢就好好用，配方非常舒服同有妝感。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Moisture Airy Fit Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: It’s true to its word: airy AND moisturizing! It blends with my skin easily and leaves no trace. The only thing I will say is that it has a certain cheesy/dairy smell to it. Other than that it delivers exactly what it promises.
reviews.zh: 真係做到佢講嘅嘢：清爽又保濕！同皮膚好容易推開，完全冇痕跡。唯一要講係佢有種芝士／奶製品嘅味道。除此之外，佢真係做到晒佢所承諾嘅嘢。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Moisture Airy Fit Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: This is a product I’ve repurchased many times. Haruharu Airy Fit sunscreen gives lightweight spf coverage that’s gentle on skin and blends in effortlessly. I have medium brown skin, and this never leaves a whitecast. My skin feels balanced after use- neither oily, nor dry, and it’s never broken me out.
reviews.zh: 呢隻產品我回購咗好多次。Haruharu Airy Fit 防曬提供輕盈嘅 SPF 保護，溫和親膚，輕鬆推開。我係中等偏深嘅膚色，用完從來都唔會泛白。用完皮膚感覺平衡——唔油亦唔乾，亦從未令我爆瘡。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Moisture Airy Fit Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Tried so many SPFs and this is my absolute favourite. It almost gives a blurring effect so I wear this a lot when I’m bare face and don’t want to use makeup. As a makeup primer it’s great - it absorbs into skin fast, the velvet finish isn’t too matte/chalky like other formulations but doesn’t make you shiny, it’s got good grip for cushion foundation-ing after. My absolute favourite spf
reviews.zh: 試過咁多款 SPF，呢隻係我嘅最愛。佢幾乎有少少磨皮效果，所以好多時我素顏又唔想化妝就會搽佢。當妝前底霜都好正——快速吸收，絲絨妝效唔會好似其他配方咁太霧面／粉感，但又唔會令你面油光滿面，搽完氣墊粉底都抓得好貼。真心係我最愛嘅 SPF。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Moisture Airy Fit Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: This one is really good, I bought it because I saw a review on tiktok and I was shocked at how good it was!! It doesn’t leave a white cast on my face and also doesn’t get greasy yet moisturizes really well! I think I will definitely purchase this again!!
reviews.zh: 呢隻真係好好用，我係喺 TikTok 睇到有人評價先買，點知好用到我嚇親！！唔會喺我塊面留低泛白，又唔會油笠，但保濕效果好好！我覺得我一定會再回購！！

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Moisture Airy Fit Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Been seeing it pop up on reels a lot. No white cast. I tend to not use moisturizer when wearing Korean sunscreens as they’re moisturizing enough for my oily skin. Doesn’t make you super glowy which I like. Wore it all day in the sun with makeup on top. Makeup still lasted as long as my favorite sunscreen.
reviews.zh: 成日喺 Reels 見到佢彈出嚟。唔會泛白。我用韓國防曬通常唔再搽保濕霜，因為對我油性肌嚟講已經夠保濕。唔會令你超級水光，呢一點我幾鍾意。搽完再上妝喺太陽下戴咗成日，妝嘅持久度同我最鍾意嗰隻防曬一樣。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Moisture Airy Fit Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: I love this sunscreen. It is so easy to blend and there is no white cast. My face feels so hydrated. However this is a thick formulation, so I think it is perfect for winters. It is great for summers as well if you live in a dry place but in humid and hot places, it is good but I think there might be better formulation out there. This is my second tube and would happily recommend this to everyone.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢隻防曬。超容易推開，完全冇泛白。塊面感覺好保濕。不過佢質地偏厚，所以我覺得秋冬用就最啱。如果住喺乾爽地方，夏天用都好好；但喺濕熱地方用得嘅，只係可能仲有更好嘅配方。呢個係我第二支，會好樂意推薦畀所有人。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Moisture Airy Fit Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: It’s my first day using this but I am in love with the finish of this sunscreen. I have been using the beauty of joseon and while that one is great it was not suited for my oily skin. This sunscreen just disappeared into my skin while leaving it moisturized and no feeling of greasiness or dryness. My skin still looks glowy but doesn’t feel it. Definitely recommend
reviews.zh: 用嘅第一日，已經愛上呢隻防曬嘅妝效。之前用緊 beauty of joseon，雖然都好好，但唔啱我油性肌。呢隻防曬直接溶入皮膚，但又留到保濕，冇油膩感亦冇乾燥感。望落去皮膚仲係有水光感，但摸落唔覺。一定推薦。
